question: The data 30, 33, 49, 51, x, x + 4, 73, 79, 85, 96 is arranged in the ascending order and the median of the data is 64. Find the value of x.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For an even number of terms (n = 10), the median is the average of the two middle terms.

The middle terms are the 5th (x) and 6th (x + 4) terms.

Median = Average of x and x + 4 = x + 2.

Given Median = 64 ⇒ x + 2 = 64.

⇒ x = 62.

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 30, 33, 49, 51, x, x + 4, 73, 79, 85, 96 (Arranged in ascending order)

Number of observations (n) = 10

Median = 64

**Formula Used:**

When n is even, Median = [(n/2)th term + (n/2 + 1)th term] ÷ 2

 
• x (5th) x + 4 (6th) 
• Median = 64 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Median = (5th term + 6th term) ÷ 2

⇒ 64 = (x + x + 4) ÷ 2

⇒ 64 × 2 = 2x + 4

⇒ 128 = 2x + 4

⇒ 2x = 128 − 4

⇒ 2x = 124

⇒ x = 124 ÷ 2

⇒ x = 62

**∴ The correct option is A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Median for Odd Observations

If n is odd, the median is the ((n + 1)/2)th term when data is arranged in order.

Mean (Average)

Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Range of Data

Range = Maximum value − Minimum value.

Empirical Formula

Relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.
